verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly is a SaaS platform that processes customer data and ships AI features, so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions an AI-training opt-out, data-usage policy, or no-training commitment. FedRAMP compliance and the AI features shown on the pricing page do not address whether customer data is used to train models.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
